## 3.1

Find out if all cell lines of the expression dataset are also represented in the Chronos dataset. If not, use only the overlapping ones. 

```{r}
intersecting_cell_lines <- intersect(rownames(chronos), rownames(expression))

plot_data <- data.table(
  cell_line = intersecting_cell_lines, 
  CDS2_effect = chronos[intersecting_cell_lines,"CDS2"], 
  CDS1_expression = expression[intersecting_cell_lines,"CDS1"]
)

plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(CDS1_expression, CDS2_effect)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth()

plot_data[, cor(CDS1_expression, CDS2_effect, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")]

```

```{r}
.d <- data.table(
    gene = colnames(expression), 
    CDS2_cor = purrr::map_dbl(colnames(expression), ~ cor(chronos[intersecting_cell_lines,"CDS2"], expression[intersecting_cell_lines,.x], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")))

ggplot(.d, aes(CDS2_cor)) + 
    geom_histogram()

```
